read.speaker: Waterlogged Tablet
read.text: The carving here has survived the flooding better: "The wardens below do not sleep, nor do they age. Karneth's word does not weaken with time, only with breach."
read.text_zh: 這裡的刻文在水患中保存得較為完整：「深處的守衛既不沉睡，也不衰老。卡奈斯之言不因時光而減弱，唯因破口而動搖。」

cont.speaker: Waterlogged Tablet
cont.text: A smaller line beneath, almost an afterthought: "He does not come for trespassers. He does not need to."
cont.text_zh: 下方還有一行較小的字，彷彿是隨手添上的：「他不會為了闖入者現身。他無需如此。」
